correctness.rationale: For every r,n>=1, centre-conditioned independent-set decomposition yields exact Walsh multipliers. Their parity characterizes all zeros. The middle-layer Krawtchouk recurrence is explicitly derived from generating polynomials; its signed double-factorial values give S_m=2^m*binom(2m+1,m). Fourier inversion gives the entire spectral-projector kernel, and translation averaging establishes global endpoint optimality. Replayed exact checker confirmed 29268 coefficients and the local identity through order 30; finite tests are corroboration only.

value.rationale: An exact two-parameter classification for the canonical family of clique windmills connects graph independence supports to harmonic-analysis rank and sharp Banach projection stability. The switch between full invertibility for odd peripheral clique order and exponentially growing minimum endpoint projection norm for even order despite asymptotically full rank is structurally meaningful. The key Krawtchouk absolute-sum identity is not obtained from unsigned graph enumeration alone.
